decision.reason: Only 169 targets have at least two prior meetings, all in bundesliga_2025_26; no other domain has a target with two prior meetings, and no target has five

feature_design.baseline: same transferable rolling goals-for/goals-against/npxG-for/npxG-against, competition and home-effect Poisson model with rho fixed to zero and no H2H input
feature_design.candidate_change: add one scalar secondary_matchup_prior coefficient anti-symmetrically to the two log rates; make no other mathematical change
feature_design.per_meeting_residual: From a strictly-prior cross-fitted baseline forecast at meeting j, orient both teams to the future target: r_j = 0.5 * ((npxG_target_home_j - lambda_target_home_j) - (npxG_target_away_j - lambda_target_away_j)); clip r_j to [-1.5, 1.5]

weight_terms.competition_j: 1 only for the target competition; otherwise the meeting is excluded
weight_terms.continuity_j: 1 for the newest meeting; for older meetings exp(-max(0, gap_to_next_newer_days - 270)/365)
weight_terms.era_j: 1 for the target season, 0.65 for the immediately prior season, and 0 otherwise
weight_terms.orientation_j: 1 when meeting home/away matches the target orientation and 0.9 when reversed

feature_design.predictive_feature: secondary_matchup_prior = clip(q * sum_j(w_j*r_j)/sum_j(w_j), -1.5, 1.5); use zero when fewer than two usable meetings
feature_design.rate_application: log(lambda_home) += beta_h2h * secondary_matchup_prior; log(lambda_away) -= beta_h2h * secondary_matchup_prior

future_hypothesis: With all non-H2H mathematics frozen, one bounded residualized H2H prior improves weighted joint-score log loss by at least 0.003 and has a block-bootstrap 95% delta interval wholly below zero without material calibration or secondary-metric degradation
leakage_controls: resolve MatchForge team IDs before forming unordered pairs
require every H2H kickoff to be strictly earlier than the target kickoff
derive each historical residual from a baseline forecast made without that meeting outcome
exclude the target outcome and all future matches
use only the authorized development snapshot
next_owner_authorization_required: Authorize additional development-history acquisition only; after the coverage floor is met, separately authorize implementation, frozen preregistration, fitting and development-only comparison

required_additional_data.coverage_floor: at least 600 targets with two or more usable prior H2H meetings and at least 300 with three or more
required_additional_data.domain_floor: qualifying targets must span at least three competitions, with at least 150 two-meeting targets in each
required_additional_data.minimum_increment_from_current: 431 additional targets with two or more meetings and 180 additional targets with three or more, including qualifying coverage in at least two competitions beyond Bundesliga
required_additional_data.suggested_source_scope: at least the immediately preceding full season for Premier League, La Liga and Serie A, followed by a new coverage-only check
